method: Finite native opportunity/settlement replay with explicit kill/participation/production profiles, fixed mission ticks and instant objective travel. No combat/survival validation.
limits: Profiles are assumptions, not empirical player cohorts; quantiles are conditional RNG distributions.
No player damage or path travel; all admitted optional tasks can be approached instantly. This overstates completion availability.
Main/expansion campaign hive reserves are fully killed; hell endless hives die after the first batch. No indefinite resource farming.
Participating queens are assigned eligible primary kills until the native 300-kill attack threshold; this is a scripted success assumption, not measured queen combat.
Input module excluded; all generated loot counted before pickup/destruction; inventory pickup is scripted, including its real capacity and successful extraction.
Only one fixed Terran roster (four Marines and a Medivac); other roster/race eligibility and real device play remain outside this replay.
quantileMethod: p10/p90 use the observed value at floor((n-1)*p); median averages the two central observations for even n.
